fact: On 19 June 2026 officials of the commune of Ntoum and the Komo-Mondah departmental council were presented Colloc-Pay, a platform for digitising and geolocating economic operators, digitising communal property and paying taxes and fees electronically, presented by Manager General Consulting.
title: Gabon/Ntoum numérique : Colloc-Pay, un nouvel outil pour renforcer les recettes des collectivités locales
